They are rectangular testing units built with a metallic frame, transparent top covers, and mounted on caster wheels. The front control panels feature bright red digital LED displays (showing readings like "001" and "009"), along with various control buttons, indicator lights (AC, DC), and a timer. Red high-voltage testing cables with alligator clips are seen extending from the side of the devices. --- ### Features - Show short circuit current (max) equipment of the spark tester. - 60 Faults/min verification of the spark tester. - High Voltage Measurement verification. - Timer to set the verification time for the spark tester. - Display number of artificial faults to actual faults. --- ### Specifications
